Name: Mi's and eemie's Butterflies
Author: Eemiestardew
Description:
WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE.
_____

Hello everyone! Mi and I thought it would be kinda fun to put out a mod that we did together. This replaces the default butterflies that you see floating about in spring and summer!
She made the 9 ones that you also can see in her [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1065/?]Framed Butterflies Displays Mod[/url], I added 3 more and did the animations.
It's only a small mod, but we hope you enjoy it nonetheless!


Place critters.xnb into the TileSheets folder, located in the Content folder.

If you want to use the Content Patcher version, you need [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿. 
Download the optional file (only the optional one!) and place it in your mods folder. Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods


Please do not re-upload/redistribute anywhere.
